title: 第3章 气运金龙小姨惊喜女教皇关注第4章 女妖精挑衅觉醒风波
slug: 废武魂我逆天进化震惊世界
content_zh:
都有什么奖励？洛凡尘心念一动，眼前出现透明面板。
【奖励一：顶级悟性！抱歉，过目不忘？只是基操。】
【奖励二：先天气运！请问，你体验过跌落山谷捡宝物，随便救济一个乞丐便是绝世高人么？】
【奖励三：满级魅力！！知道什么是行走的尖叫鸡吗，淡定的是你，尖叫的永远是别人。】
【奖励四：仙姿玉骨，逆天神颜！！！你的颜值有毒，毒翻了芸芸众生，让妖精、魔女们不知不觉沦陷其中。】
嘶——
查看完奖励，洛凡尘眸中绽放光彩，狠，太狠了。
话说系统这是啥意思？暗示自己要开香车当渣男？
呸，他是那种仗着自己有点小运气，有点颜值，有一些小运气就为所欲为的人么。
坏系统别想带坏你良善的主人。
洛凡尘能看见面板，饭桌对面苏玖儿看不见啊，芳心乱颤，这小男人盯着自己那火热兴奋的眼神是怎么回事。
听说人类男人，到了年龄就开始有那种念头……
想女人了。
苏玖儿饭桌下一双玉腿不自觉并拢，翘臀儿收了收，正襟危坐，拿出了姨的风范。
“凡尘，你听姨说，你现在还小，身子还没长成，有些事还早。”
“啊？”
洛凡尘光关注系统了，差点忘了对面还坐着千娇百媚的大美人。
苏玖儿美眸一瞪，露出长辈一般的威严。
“还跟姨装傻，你刚才那狼崽子见肉一样的激动眼神姨可都看见啦，你现在身子骨太弱，不行的。”
啊这……

洛凡尘无语，这是误会了啊，系统的事又不能解释，只能道：
“我都能单手擒野猪了，还弱嘛？”
苏玖儿面颊一红，这是暗示我身强体壮，可以干体力活了么。
她啐道：“小兔崽子，有话不能明说么，绕来绕去的，你想要，姨还能不给你么？”
“但不能是现在，以后你就知道了，女人可比那野猪可怕多了，尤其姨还是狐族的女帝。”
三十如狼，四十如虎，五十能吸土？
洛凡尘下意识想起前世一句话，接着摇头，这都什么跟什么，女妖精给他带歪了。
不能解释，越解释越乱，洛凡尘迅速扒拉两口饭，随后说自己吃完了，跑回房间。
苏玖儿被晾在原位，愣住。
“小男人这是被戳破心思生气了？”
“也是，只让看不让碰确实过分，看来得给他点甜头，哄哄他。”
妖娆美妇想起前几日在城里买的特殊物件，精致冷颜羞红一片，贝齿一咬，就它吧。
她望着屋子的方向，轻声啐道：“便宜你了臭男人，谁叫你是我的童养夫呢。”
静谧木屋内，洛凡尘坐在床头。
他和苏玖儿一直都是分房睡，苏玖儿怕他忍不住。
毕竟那祸水红颜，火辣娇躯，以及天狐自带的惊人魅力哪怕刻意收敛也不是五肢健全的人能把持住的。
不对，貌似是人是兽都把持不住。
洛凡尘叹息，可惜实力不足，哪怕美食就在眼前，也无福消受，不然可能会被阴气灌体冲到雕爆。
好在明天就可以觉醒武魂，飞速提高实力的契机来了。
“系统，领取奖励！”

刚才在外面，他怕动静太大，就没着急领。
“昂！”
白云悠悠，皓日当空。
一道庞大的虚幻金色龙影自九霄云外飞来，俯冲向地面，穿过房顶，没入洛凡尘天灵盖。
“轰——”
content_en:
What are the rewards? Luo Fanchen thought, and a transparent panel appeared in front of his eyes.
[Reward 1: Top understanding! Sorry, photographic memory? Just basic sex. 】
[Reward 2: Innate weather luck! Excuse me, have you ever experienced falling into a valley to pick up treasures? Are you a peerless expert when you just help a beggar? 】
[Reward Three: Full Level Charm! ! Do you know what a walking screaming chicken is? You are the one who is calm, but it is always others who scream. 】
[Reward 4: Immortal posture and jade bones, heaven-defying beauty! ! ! Your appearance is poisonous, poisoning all living beings, causing fairies and witches to fall into it unknowingly. 】
Hiss——
After checking the reward, Luo Fanchen's eyes sparkled, cruel, too cruel.
What do you mean by system? Suggesting that he wants to drive a fancy car and become a scumbag?
Phew, is he the kind of person who does whatever he wants with a little bit of luck, good looks, and a little bit of luck?
Don't try to bring down your good master with a bad system.
Luo Fanchen could see the panel, but Su Jiuer across the dining table couldn't. His heart trembled, wondering what was going on with the hot and excited eyes of this little man staring at him.
I heard that human men start to have that kind of thoughts when they get older...
I miss women.
Su Jiu'er's legs were unconsciously brought together under the dining table, her buttocks were retracted, and she sat upright, showing off her aunty demeanor.
"Fanchen, listen to what my aunt said. You are still young and your body has not yet grown up. It is still early for some things."
"Huh?"
Luo Fanchen was so focused on the system that he almost forgot that there was a charming beauty sitting across from him.
Su Jiuer's beautiful eyes widened, showing the majesty of an elder.
"You're still pretending to be stupid. I saw the excited look in your eyes just now, like a wolf cub seeing flesh. You're too weak now, so you can't do it."
Ah this...
Luo Fanchen was speechless. This was a misunderstanding. He couldn't explain the system, so he could only say:
"I can catch a wild boar with one hand, am I still weak?"
Su Jiu'er's cheeks turned red. Does this mean that I am strong and can do physical work?
She spat: "Little bastard, can't you say something clearly? I'm going around and around. If you want it, can I still deny it to you?"
"But not now. You will know later that women are much scarier than that wild boar, especially since I am the empress of the Fox Clan."
Thirty is like a wolf, forty is like a tiger, fifty can absorb dirt?
Luo Fanchen subconsciously remembered a sentence from his previous life, and then shook his head. This was nothing, and the female demon had misled him.
Unable to explain, the more he explained, the more confused he became. Luo Fanchen quickly took two mouthfuls of food, then said he had finished eating and ran back to the room.
Su Jiu'er was left in her original position, stunned.
"Is the little man angry because his thoughts have been exposed?"
"That's right. It's really too much to just keep him out of touch. It seems like we need to give him some sweetness and coax him."
The enchanting and beautiful woman thought of the special item she bought in the city a few days ago, her delicate and cold face flushed with shame, she bit her teeth and said, that's it.
She looked in the direction of the house and spat softly: "You are so advantageous, stinky man, why do you think you are my child adopter?"
In the quiet wooden house, Luo Fanchen sat on the bedside.
He and Su Jiu'er have always slept in separate rooms, and Su Jiu'er was afraid that he couldn't bear it.
After all, the beautiful face, the hot body, and the amazing charm of Tianhu are not something that a healthy person can control even if he deliberately restrains them.
No, it seems that neither humans nor beasts can control it.
Luo Fanchen sighed, but unfortunately he was not strong enough. Even if the food was right in front of him, he would not be able to enjoy it, otherwise he might be filled with yin energy and explode.
Fortunately, you can awaken your martial soul tomorrow and have the opportunity to rapidly improve your strength.
"System, collect the reward!"
When he was outside just now, he was afraid of too much noise, so he didn't rush to get it.
"Ang!"
The white clouds are long and the sun is bright in the sky.
A huge illusory golden dragon shadow flew from outside Jiuxiao Cloud, swooped towards the ground, passed through the roof, and sank into Luo Fanchen's Heavenly Spirit Cap.
"boom--"
